title: Latency Corridor + Token Tide Microcards: Per-route performance spec
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Design spec for a compact per-route performance module composed of a Latency Corridor (time-distribution view) and Token Tide microcards (token composition + cost overlay). Goal: provide route owners an at-a-glance, scannable summary that surfaces regressions (p50/p95/p99), token mix shifts (input/output/cached), and a quick compare mode across model variants or recent rollouts.
motivation_and_goals: Help engineers and PMs detect subtle regressions quickly without drilling into full trace data
Support fast QA during canary rollouts by making small differences visible in a 3–4 tile panel
Preserve clarity at small width (card width >= 280px) for Console list pages and route detail sidebars
proposed_composition: Tile A — Latency Corridor: compact density plot with overlaid p50/p95/p99 markers and a shaded IQR; supports hover microtraces and instant switch to timeline view
Tile B — Token Tide: stacked area showing input / output / cached tokens over time with a thin cost-per-token line on secondary axis
Tile C — Throughput Sparkline: 1h/6h/24h toggle with autoscaling annotations (when Dedicated autoscale events occurred)
Tile D — Quick Compare: two-line diff overlay for selected model variants or two time windows (baseline vs current)
chart_spec_requirements: Latency Corridor: render kernel as smooth density (approx KDE) computed from pre-aggregated buckets. Visual elements: density fill, median marker (solid), p95/p99 dashed lines, tooltip with sample microtrace link
Latency axis: linear ms scale up to configurable clip; when > 10s show truncated symbol and tooltip with tail count

Token Tide: stacked area with layers in order [input, output, cached]; area colors chosen for accessibility (contrast ratio >= 4.5:1); hover shows absolute counts and percent change vs previous window
Cost overlay: thin dashed line mapped to right y-axis in $/k tokens; tunable smoothing to avoid noisy spikes; clicking cost point opens cost breakdown drawer
Throughput Sparkline: use step area with rolling-mean overlay and event markers for autoscale or fallback; clicking a marker drills to rollout timeline
Quick Compare Mode: delta shading with percent delta label and significance threshold (default 5%); when delta crosses threshold show inline CTA to open eval set
interaction_patterns: Hover: show tooltip with metric slice, sample request IDs and link to microtrace panel
Range selection: drag on corridor to set time window for all tiles; keyboard accessible via arrow keys to nudge window
Variant compare: select up to 2 model variants; switch to compare retains original baseline selection across routes
Context menu: right-click a tile to pin snapshot to route notes or create a rollout checkpoint
Responsive: collapse to single-column microcards on narrow screens, maintain primary KPI tiles
performance_considerations: Prefer pre-aggregated bucketed histograms emitted from the serving runtime rather than client-side KDE for large routes
SVG for microcards with Canvas fallback for very large point series (>100k points) to keep Console interactive
Lazy-load heavy tiles when panel is off-screen; initial LCP-friendly skeletons
Use token-level precomputation for Token Tide to avoid per-request recompute in the UI
accessibility_and_a11y: Color palette to meet AA contrast for text and graphical markers
All interactive elements reachable via keyboard, with ARIA labels describing chart focus and selections
Provide an accessible numeric summary mode (text) for screen readers that outputs p50/p95/p99 and token ratios
engineering_notes_and_constraints: Backend should surface histogram buckets at 1s/10s/100s bins depending on route volume
Provide endpoints to fetch 'compare snapshots' (route+variant+time) to avoid client-side full historical pulls
Attach sample microtrace IDs (3–5) per bucket to allow lightweight drill-through
Ensure the UI can opt-out of KDE smoothing for exact histogram plotting when requested by eng

acceptance_criteria: Console shows Latency Corridor + Token Tide microcards in route detail and route list expansion with correct data mapping
Compare mode returns consistent delta numbers (matching server-side snapshot diffs) and highlights thresholds
Hover microtrace links open route microtrace panel and show sample request IDs
Performance requirement: initial route panel render < 600ms for typical routes (<= 1000rps) on standard engineering machines
Unit/e2e test coverage for UI interactions (hover, drag window, compare) and backend snapshot endpoints
